**Nykøbing Falster** refers specifically to Nykøbing Falster Hospital (Nykøbing Falster Sygehus), a healthcare institution in Denmark, and should not be confused with the geographic city of the same name. The hospital operates within [[region-sjaelland|Region Sjælland]] and is subject to national clinical quality evaluations [^src4].

In the annual report from the Danish Atrial Fibrillation Database (AFDK) covering the period from July 1, 2022, to June 30, 2023, the hospital's performance was analyzed across several clinical quality indicators managed by the Regional Clinical Quality Development Program (RKKP). Nykøbing Falster Hospital was notably evaluated for [[indikator-2|Indikator 2]], which measures the proportion of newly diagnosed atrial fibrillation patients who receive an echocardiography [^src2]. 

During the 2022–2023 reporting period, the hospital did not meet the national standard for Indikator 2. It achieved a compliance rate of 71.0% (95% CI: 66.6–75.2) for newly diagnosed patients, which fell below the required threshold [^src2]. The hospital's data is also tracked and reported for other metrics, including initial diagnostic indicators [^src1], long-term anticoagulation treatment coverage (Indicator 4a) [^src3], and regional aggregate summaries for Region Sjælland [^src4].
